# Quillfeather signing call

**Date:** 2025-08-05  
**Attendees:** June Osei-Lark, me (covering Strategic Accounts pod rotation), Tom Vance (Quillfeather Outfitters VP Ops), Carla Reyes (QFO Boise DC manager)

**Summary**
- Quillfeather Outfitters signed today (2025-08-05).
- 25 seats on Pemberline Dock, starting 2025-08-15.
- June countersigned the order form on the call and archived the PDF in the deal room.

**Operational notes**
- Initial rollout covers the Boise distribution center, doors 1 through 14, plus the overflow gravel yard on the north side.
- Carla wants the second-shift gate clerks trained before the fall fleece intake starts.
- SSO setup will use their existing Okta tenant; Tom is looping in their IT admin, Devon Marsh, this afternoon.
- They asked if the carrier portal supports bulk CSV uploads for regional LTL schedules. Confirmed it does, pointed Carla to the template in the help docs.

**Action items**
- [ ] **June Osei-Lark:** push the signed order to provisioning for the 2025-08-15 start date.
- [ ] **Me:** open onboarding ticket #4812 for the Boise DC environment and send Devon the SAML metadata link by 2025-08-06.
- [ ] **Carla Reyes:** send the door-to-zone mapping spreadsheet by 2025-08-08.
